scope_classification: NATIVE_MAXWELL_KERNEL_REFERENCE: real hadronic branch (BBB_BHF2 single CompOSE core table) + SYNTHETIC CSS high-density branch (Alford-Han-Prakash quark phase). This is NOT a source-backed crust-core Maxwell production PASS: the hadronic phase is a single core model, not a crust-core splice, and the high phase is a parameterised synthetic quark phase.
method: native Fortran construct_maxwell_transition (single-conserved-charge baryon-number sharp coexistence with LOCAL charge neutrality imposed in each phase; NOT a Gibbs mixed phase, NOT a smooth crust-core interpolation)

phase_low.provenance: Raw CompOSE eos.thermo header (line 1): mn=939.56533, mp=938.272. Source-decimal rounding of canonical Typel 2010 arXiv:0908.2344 Table II values (939.56536, 938.27203). Retained verbatim.

phase_high.mn_status: normalisation_metadata (copied from hadronic; NOT a physical nucleon mass for deconfined matter)
phase_high.mp_status: normalisation_metadata (copied from hadronic; NOT a physical nucleon mass for deconfined matter)

mass_pairs.pairwise_gate_check: low%mn==high%mn AND low%mp==high%mp (pairwise, independent mn/mp comparison, rtol=1e-12). mn!=mp within a phase is ALLOWED; the gate is L-vs-H only.

consistency_checks_scope: Native C1-C11 and Seidov checks apply to the single-conserved-charge baryon-number sharp coexistence with local charge neutrality. They do NOT validate a Gibbs mixed phase, composition conservation, or multi-charge thermodynamics.
